description: Search available homes and commercial properties in Metastate's live portfolio in Portugal (Lisbon, Cascais, Sintra, Oeiras…), for sale or rent. Returns reference, title, operation, price (or monthly rent), type, size, area and listing link. / Procura imóveis disponíveis na carteira da Metastate, para venda ou arrendamento.

piscina.description: true = only properties with a pool

preco_min.description: Minimum price in euros (monthly rent for rentals)

texto.description: Free keywords, e.g. river view, golf, office
